entry.title: How the region fits together, on one chart
entry.summary: Three lines: how The Upskilling Labs of Greater Washington is organised, the clock the Cycle runs on, and the route a person takes through both. Where they meet is where the value changes hands.

entry.title: Every way we’ve heard of getting lost, on one map
entry.summary: We wrote down everything people have told us about trying to find their way around The Labs. Then we drew it. Here’s what we saw, and what we still can’t see.

entry.title: Our first prototype is a Metro map
entry.summary: An events list tells you what’s on. A map tells you whether you can get there. So the region put every library on the Metro.

entry.title: What 54 case studies are teaching us about wayfinding
entry.summary: Most programs design the last day. The people who stay were won on the days nobody designed. Here’s what 54 of them are teaching us.
